body: Forward test of the management-tone-vs-delivery method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.42 (naive base rate 0.60) that: Eicher Motors Q3 FY27 consolidated operating margin is ≥24.0%. Evidence: Q2 FY27 call (13-Nov-2026): record revenue ₹7,422 cr (+20%), EBITDA ₹1,760 cr; Royal Enfield Q2 volume 376,722 (+15%), YTD Apr–Oct ~+18%, bookings +21% YTD, 'highest-ever monthly sales in September and October', channel stock below normal. Three price hikes in CY26; CEO Vidhya Srinivasan: 'we don't give forward-looking guidances… there is volatility'; MD Govindarajan: 'the range bound on the percentage is not what is driving us… absolute profit'; analyst notes 'other expenditure surge'. Screener OPM (OP÷Sales): Q3 FY26 25.5% (1,557/6,114), Q4 FY26 24.9%, Q1 FY27 24.0% (1,591/6,632), Q2 FY27 23.7% (1,760/7,422). Cheyyar module 1 started Q2 FY27 (capacity 1.65 mn), module 2 pulled into Q4 FY27. Reasoning: Management repeatedly steered analysts away from margin percentage toward absolute profit while costs (steel, freight, marketing, new-plant ramp) rise — a tone we read as a soft warning. Two consecutive quarters at/below 24% and new capacity costs lean below the naive 'stays near recent levels' base. Resolution: YES if Eicher Motors' consolidated Operating Profit ÷ Sales for the quarter ended 31-Dec-2026, from screener.in's consolidated quarterly table (or recomputed as EBITDA ÷ revenue from operations from the results filing), is ≥24.0% (one decimal). Source: Eicher Motors Q3 FY27 results (NSE filing) / screener.in consolidated quarterly table. Resolve by 2027-02-28; score with Brier vs base rate.
